extracted.intended_audience: researchers conducting or reading biomedical systematic reviews and meta-analyses (dentistry/periodontology researchers, epidemiologists, clinicians interested in biomarkers)
extracted.subtask_description: Designing and reporting a PRISMA-compliant systematic review and meta-analysis comparing serum biomarker levels between disease and healthy groups (here: serum MMP-8 in periodontitis vs healthy controls). Includes protocol registration, literature search, quality assessment, data standardization, meta-analysis and sensitivity analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA compliance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The study is described as PRISMA-compliant, indicating adherence to PRISMA reporting guidelines for systematic reviews and meta-analyses (transparent reporting of search strategy, study selection, data extraction, risk of bias assessment, synthesis, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive literature search across major databases
rubrics_metrics.description: A comprehensive search of Pubmed, Embase and Cochrane Library was conducted to retrieve comprehensive relevant articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search should include key bibliographic databases (at minimum PubMed, Embase, Cochrane) to capture relevant literature; implies use of systematic search strategies and documentation of sources searched.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear comparison groups and outcome definition (PICO)
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine whether serum matrix metalloproteinase-8 (MMP-8) level is elevated in periodontitis patients comparing to periodontally healthy subjects; assess diagnostic value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify population (periodontitis patients vs periodontally healthy subjects), intervention/exposure (serum MMP-8 level as biomarker), comparator, and outcome(s) (serum MMP-8 levels, diagnostic performance). Clear definition of comparison and outcome is required for study inclusion and pooling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protocol registration (OSF)
rubrics_metrics.description: OSF registration: Generalized Systematic Review Registration (Osf_registration_doi 10.17605/OSF.IO/2UYBN).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Register the review protocol (here on OSF) prior to conducting the review to increase transparency and reduce selective reporting; include registration identifier in the report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodological quality / risk-of-bias assessment using Newcastle-Ottawa Scale (NOS)
rubrics_metrics.description: The methodological qualities of the included articles were evaluated following Newcastle-Ottawa Scale (NOS) grading system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess included observational studies' quality/risk of bias with a recognized tool (NOS) and report grading; use results to inform interpretation and potential sensitivity/subgroup analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data standardization for pooling (convert to Mean ± SD)
rubrics_metrics.description: The level of serum MMP-8 was converted to standard forms (Mean ± SD) for meta-analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transform reported outcome metrics into consistent summary statistics (e.g., mean ± SD) before pooling; document conversion methods and assumptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of appropriate meta-analysis software and methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Meta-analysis was conducted by Review Manager 5.4 software.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conduct quantitative synthesis with validated meta-analysis software (e.g., RevMan); specify models used (fixed/random effects), effect measures, heterogeneity metrics, and pooling methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Perform sensitivity analyses to test robustness
rubrics_metrics.description: Sensitivity analyses were performed by Stata 17.0 software.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conduct sensitivity analyses (e.g., excluding low-quality studies, alternative effect measures, different statistical models) using appropriate statistical software (here Stata) to evaluate stability of findings.
